While 'hr_employee' has a 'store_id', the 'hr_payroll' table only links to 'hr_employee' via 'emp_id'. However, the 'hr_employee' table in this schema does not contain a 'store_id' column; only the 'employee' table (which seems to be a different entity or a different view of employees) contains 'store_id'. Therefore, it is impossible to attribute payroll records to specific stores.
